svg.title: The spotlight of high derivatives
svg.desc: Computed: kernels u^k e^{-u}/k! (normalized to peak 1) with k = ceil(1.25 U) for U = 20, 40, 80, 160 and the windows [U, 1.5 U] in u = log y; labels give the fraction of each kernel's mass inside its window.
